title: DataFlow Studio — plan the end-to-end deploy
description: Runs `nexus deploy dataflow-studio` to plan the application project's container deploy end-to-end (build images → run the OltpDb / StarRocks / ClickHouse migrations → deploy the Api tier to Kubernetes). The dry-run is idempotent and needs no lab. DataFlow Studio itself is the CDC → curated Avro → StarRocks DWH + ClickHouse telemetry pipeline that observes itself across three planes (Tempo traces, ClickHouse pipeline_events, Marquez lineage).

observe.what: a five-step deploy plan table (build-images → migrate-oltp → migrate-starrocks → migrate-clickhouse → deploy-k8s), each row showing the exact docker/kubectl command it would run
'(dry-run — re-run with --execute --yes to apply)' — nothing is executed
the same plan as machine-readable JSON (project, repoPath, steps[]) for piping into other tooling

whatProves: A single AOT binary plans an application project's full container deploy — build, migrate (three engines), and deploy to Kubernetes — from the project's own committed deploy/ recipes; the deployed project is a governed, self-observing CDC-to-DWH pipeline.
